## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation flow still accepts passwords of eight to eleven characters, so the pull request does not fully apply the twelve-character minimum it describes; see "Raise the invite validator minimum to twelve".

## Changes
The pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py`, and updates their boundary tests to cover lengths 11, 12 and 13. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator minimum to twelve — An 11-character password such as `"x" * 11` is still accepted by `accepts_password` in the stale `app/invite.py:1`, which keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`, while signup and reset now reject it. The PR body says the change "raises the minimum in the password validators", but only two of the three validators change. — Invited users can still set passwords shorter than the twelve characters the security policy requires. — Fix: Set `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12` in `app/invite.py:1` and extend `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py:6` in the same way as the signup and reset tests.
